department: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department (Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission), Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Working women got help to buy a gearless two-wheeler: half the price or Rs 25,000, whichever is less. Differently abled women got Rs 31,200 for a retrofitted three-wheeler scooter.

other: You must be a working woman, and your income must be the main income of your family.
You must live in Tamil Nadu and have a two-wheeler licence or learner's licence.
You must have written the class 8 exam (pass or fail).

documents: Two-wheeler driving licence or learner's licence
how_to_apply: Forms were given free at Block offices, Urban Local Body offices and Collectorates.
where_to_apply: Block office, Urban Local Body office or Collectorate
